headline: Tanzania Mining and Investment Conference 2026 Confirms 1,715 Participants Ahead of 19 November Opening
summary: The Tanzania Mining and Investment Conference 2026 has 1,715 confirmed participants, including 226 from abroad, ahead of its 19–21 November programme in Dar es Salaam. Minister Anthony Mavunde outlined progress on domestic mineral processing.
why: Mining investment conferences signal policy direction and deal flow for resource companies operating in host countries such as Tanzania. Domestic processing rules affect project economics for miners.
